name: Image and Text
description: Main hero banner with optional text, ctas, and layout styles

attribute_definitions.name: Image Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the image container of the component (entire block containing image and text). Useful for overriding padding and margin. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Image Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the image itself. Useful for overriding padding and margin. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Desktop Image
attribute_definitions.description: For faster load time, please use images under 500 KB.

attribute_definitions.name: Mobile Image
attribute_definitions.description: For faster load time, please use images under 500 KB.

attribute_definitions.name: Alt Text
attribute_definitions.description: The image alt text shown by the component.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust the styling, spacing, and alignment of the title. e.g. 'mb-2' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust the styling, spacing, and alignment of the subtitle. e.g. 'mb-2' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Sub Title Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Sub Title font size, default is 16px

attribute_definitions.name: Select gird Only when using button alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Select grid property only when using button alignment, Otherwise leave it unchanged

attribute_definitions.name: Button Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust the styling, spacing, and alignment of the button. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Button Text Color
attribute_definitions.description: Default color is white for tertiary button

attribute_definitions.name: Button Style
attribute_definitions.description: Select button styling, default is btn-primary

attribute_definitions.name: Button Alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Select button Alignment, default is unset

attribute_definitions.name: CTA Aria-label
attribute_definitions.description: Aria-label is an attribute that provides an accessible name for screen readers helping users understand the purpose of an element.
